lead.headline: US CBDC ban becomes law as AI trading agents colonize retail crypto infrastructure
lead.tldr: The US just foreclosed on Fed-issued digital dollars while Robinhood and Kraken race to deploy AI agents for crypto execution, creating a sharp policy-technology divergence: stateless money automation is accelerating just as sovereign digital currency gets legislated out of existence.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why the gap between automated crypto execution and sovereign digital currency just became a defining structural tension.

top_signals.title: Housing bill that includes a CBDC ban passed into law without Trump's signature
top_signals.summary: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act has officially become law, incorporating a critical provision that prohibits the Federal Reserve from issuing a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC). The bill passed into law without requiring a signature from President Trump.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The CBDC ban removes a persistent tail-risk for private stablecoin issuers and crypto dollarization plays, effectively guaranteeing that dollar-denominated digital liquidity will remain privatized and offshore-structured for the foreseeable future.

top_signals.title: Hedera lending protocol Bonzo Lend hit for $9 million after Supra verifier accepts manipulated price update
top_signals.summary: The Hedera-based lending protocol Bonzo Lend suffered a $9 million exploit due to a manipulated price update accepted by a Supra verifier. While most funds were drained, a white hat hacker has claimed approximately $1 million and pledged to return it.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Bonzo exploit exposes how oracle verification architectures remain the single most underpriced attack vector in DeFi lending, particularly for newer L1 ecosystems where verifier networks lack the economic security depth of Ethereum mainnet.

top_signals.title: Stablecoins May Improve FX Access but Worsen Currency Runs: IMF
top_signals.summary: The IMF has released a paper analyzing the impact of dollar-backed stablecoins on foreign exchange markets. While they may improve FX access, the IMF warns they could accelerate currency runs by signaling dollar scarcity to the market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The IMF's framing signals that stablecoins are graduating from regulatory curiosity to macroprudential concern, which typically precedes heavier cross-border reporting requirements and capital control coordination that could compress offshore stablecoin velocity.

top_signals.title: Robinhood to Launch AI Agent Feature For Crypto Trading
top_signals.summary: Robinhood is expanding its AI agent trading capabilities to include cryptocurrency. This feature will allow agentic accounts to execute crypto trades on behalf of users, mirroring its existing functionality for equities and options.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Robinhood's AI agent expansion represents a meaningful distribution moat for retail crypto execution, potentially concentrating order flow in ways that reshape maker-taker dynamics and payment for order flow economics in digital assets.

top_signals.title: Kraken Plans AI-Powered Trading App Overhaul, CNBC Reports
top_signals.summary: Kraken is planning a comprehensive overhaul of its trading application to integrate AI-powered trading agents. This move reflects a broader trend of crypto exchanges and fintech firms adopting artificial intelligence to enhance digital finance services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Kraken's AI overhaul suggests the exchange tier is converging on agentic trading as a table-stakes feature, which will compress margins for pure execution venues and advantage those with proprietary AI or data infrastructure.

on_the_radar.summary: Five US Senators are calling for committee hearings to investigate whether President Donald Trump's policies are being influenced by crypto funding. The inquiry specifically focuses on ties to UAE-linked entities and coincides with discussions regarding the CLARITY Act.

Goettsche had been facing charges of conspiracy to commit wire fraud and selling unregistered securities.

linkedin_post: A lot of people saw the CBDC ban and filed it under 'crypto wins Washington.' That is the wrong read. The 21st Century ROAD Act passed without Trump's signature, which tells you how mechanically bipartisan this was, and what it actually does is lock in the privatization of digital dollars. No Fed-issued instrument, no sovereign liability, no monetary policy transmission. The dollar in crypto stays a private claim. Meanwhile Robinhood is launching AI agents for crypto trading and Kraken is overhauling its entire app around the same premise. So the architecture is becoming clear: automated execution on stateless rails, denominated in privatized stablecoins, running on infrastructure that regulators can observe but cannot intermediate. We have underwritten the exchange and stablecoin layers on the assumption of regulatory arbitrage, and this split feels mispriced. The market is pricing in a US crypto thaw, but the value proposition is shifting from regulatory relief to execution infrastructure. The firms that capture agentic order flow will extract rents regardless of whether the SEC approves your token. I'd watch how Robinhood's crypto agent volumes trade versus its equities flow, and whether that concentration gets repriced as a systemic risk. Equities got the headline; the agent infrastructure did the work.
